person.title: Senior Data Engineer · Data Scientist
person.summary: Senior Data Engineer and Data Scientist with 10+ years building data platforms for hospitals and federal agencies in Switzerland. Apache NiFi, Airflow, PySpark, Iceberg. Hands-on and exact; coaches junior engineers and ships in Scrum / SAFe teams.
person.summary_de: Senior Data Engineer und Data Scientist mit über 10 Jahren Erfahrung im Aufbau von Datenplattformen für Spitäler und Bundesstellen in der Schweiz. Apache NiFi, Airflow, PySpark, Iceberg. Hands-on und exakt — coacht Junior-Ingenieure und liefert im Scrum / SAFe-Team.

experiences.description: Develop and operate the existing clinical data platform (.NET C#) including Prometheus/Grafana monitoring. Build a modern Kubernetes-based data platform on open-source tools.
experiences.description_de: Entwicklung & Betreuung der bestehenden Clinical Data Platform (.NET C#) inkl. Monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana). Aufbau einer modernen Data-Platform auf Kubernetes mit Open-Source-Tools.

experiences.description: Operated and extended the data analytics platform and the data lake. Built pipelines in Python and PySpark using Apache NiFi, Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, Dremio, S3, Postgres, Git, Kafka, Docker and Linux. Worked in a Scrum / SAFe / DevOps setup.
experiences.description_de: Betreuung und Entwicklung der Data-Analytics-Plattform und des Datalakes. Entwicklung in Python und PySpark. Tools: Apache NiFi, Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, Dremio, S3, Postgres, Git, Kafka, Docker, Linux. Arbeitsmethodik: Scrum / SAFe / DevOps.

experiences.description: Maintained the hospital information system CGM Clinical (Delphi scripting, MS SQL, Crystal Reports). Built applications in PHP, JavaScript, CSS and HTML.
experiences.description_de: Betreuung des Klinikinformationssystems CGM Clinical (Skriptsprache Delphi, MS SQL, Crystal Reports). Applikationsentwicklung in PHP, JS, CSS und HTML.

experiences.description: Full-stack software developer in C# (ASP.NET, .NET Core, JavaScript, CSS, HTML).
experiences.description_de: Fullstack Software Developer in C# (ASP.NET, .NET Core, JS, CSS, HTML).

experiences.description: Further development of the hospital information system CGM Clinical. Sub-project lead of the Siloah rollout in Gümligen (Hermes, Scrum, Jira, Confluence).
experiences.description_de: Weiterentwicklung des Klinikinformationssystems CGM Clinical. Teilprojektleiter der Einführung Spital Siloah in Gümligen (Hermes, Scrum, Jira, Confluence).

experiences.description: Project manager in the Automation, Motors & Drives business unit.

educations.description: CAS: Software Development (Java), Data Analysis (R), Big Data, Practical Machine Learning (Python). Master thesis: development of a Clinical Decision Support System for sepsis patients using machine-learning technologies (Spark-ML, Python).
educations.description_de: CAS: Software Development (JAVA), Datenanalyse (R-Scripting), Big Data, Practical Machine Learning (Python). Masterthesis: Entwicklung eines Clinical Decision Support Systems für Sepsis-Patienten/-innen mit ML-Technologien (Spark-ML, Python).

educations.description: Focus areas: medical engineering, mechatronics, robotics. Bachelor thesis: 'Development of a tribometer to investigate friction coefficients between organic and inorganic materials in the field of endoprosthetics'.
educations.description_de: Vertiefungsrichtungen: Medizintechnik, Mechatronik, Robotik. Bachelorthesis: „Entwicklung eines Tribometers zur Untersuchung des Reibungskoeffizienten zwischen organischen und anorganischen Stoffen im Bereich der Endoprothetik".

educations.description: Medical studies at the University of Bern. Passed the first and second pre-clinical examinations. Co-author of a peer-reviewed paper on urinary calcium and phosphorus excretion in preterm infants.
educations.description_de: Studium der Humanmedizin an der Universität Bern. Erstes und zweites Propädeutikum abgeschlossen. Zweit-Autor einer Studie: „Monitoring of Urinary Calcium and Phosphorus Excretion in Preterm Infants: Comparison of 2 Methods".
